imagePicker.title: Image for {{variant}}

alert.hint: The assistant tells customers when something is unavailable.

list.description: What the assistant can sell. It quotes these prices and checks this stock when customers ask.
list.label: Products
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, tag or SKU
list.title: Catalog

options.editHint: Removing a value removes the variants that use it when you save.
options.limit: A product can have up to {{max}} options.
options.menuHint: Up to {{max}} options per product. Each combination becomes a variant.
options.name: Option name
options.nameHint: The assistant uses this name when it asks customers to choose.
options.nameTaken: This product already has an option with this name.
options.newVariantsHint: New variants copy the price and image of the variant they come from, and start with no stock.
options.search: Search or type a new option
options.title: Options
options.tooManyValues: An option can have up to {{max}} values.
options.tooManyVariants: That's more than {{max}} variants. Use fewer values.
options.valuePlaceholder: Type a value and press Enter
options.valueTaken: {{value}} is already a value of this option.
options.valuesHint: Customers see them in this order.

organisation.aliasesHint: Other names customers use for it, separated with commas. Helps the assistant find it.
organisation.categoriesHint: A product can be in more than one category. Customers and the assistant find it in each one.
organisation.loadFailed: Categories couldn't be loaded. Refresh to try again.
organisation.title: Organisation

photos.full: A product can have up to {{max}} photos.
photos.hint: The default photo is what the assistant sends when a customer hasn't picked a variant, and for any variant without its own image. Change it in All photos.
photos.saveFirst: Save the product first, then add its photos.
photos.title: Photos

status.hint: Published: the assistant offers it to customers. Draft: only you can see it while you finish it. Archived: no longer sold, kept for past orders.
status.title: Status

upload.description: {{name}} has {{count}} photos, so you can add up to {{room}} more · JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each
upload.hint: New photos go after the existing ones. Your default photo stays the same.
upload.listHint: Choose a photo in the list to preview it. New photos go after the existing ones; your default photo stays the same. Change it in All photos.
upload.title: Add photos

variants.descriptionMany: Only the combinations you sell, each with its own price, stock and image. Without a name, the assistant calls a variant by its option values.
variants.descriptionNone: One price, stock and image for the whole product. Add an option, like Size, to sell it in more than one variant.
variants.descriptionOne: Each {{option}} has its own name, image, price and stock. One without its own image uses the default photo. A variant is called by its {{option}} until you name it. The assistant uses the name when it talks to customers.
variants.missing: Pick a value for each option to add that combination. Missing now: {{list}}.
variants.noneMissing: Every combination is in the table.
variants.stockInvalid: Enter a whole number, like 0 or 12.
variants.title: Variants
